test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.

They said, "We need more time."

options.text: They said they needed more time.
They said they need more time.
They said they had need more time.
They said that we needed more time.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said they needed more time.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"We" becomes "they"**
 
 
• The first-person pronoun "We" changes to the third-person pronoun "they" to align with the subject of the reporting verb ("They").
 
 
 
• **"need" becomes "needed"**
 
 
• Because the reporting verb "said" is in the past tense, the simple present verb "need" in the direct speech backshifts to the simple past tense "needed" in the indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Formatting and conjunction:**
 
 
• The comma and quotation marks are removed. The conjunction "that" is optionally used to link the clauses; in this correct option, it is naturally omitted.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *They said they needed more time.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** They said they need more time.

 
 
• Incorrectly retains the present tense verb "need" instead of properly backshifting it to the past tense to match the reporting verb.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** They said they had need more time.
 
 
• Uses a grammatically incorrect verb construction ("had need"). 
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** They said that we needed more time.
 
 
• Fails to convert the pronoun "we" to "they," which alters the meaning of who exactly is requiring the time.
